components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: A top-bar or sidebar destination with theme-aware blue active and focus states.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { color: var(--vp-c-text-1, #3c3c43); font: 500 14px/1.45 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.25s; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--vp-c-brand-1, #1d4ed8); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--vp-c-brand-2, #2563eb); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Local Search Field
components.description: The local-search query field used inside VitePress's detailed search view.
components.html: <input class="ds-search-field" type="search" aria-label="Search checklist" placeholder="Search the checklist">
components.css: .ds-search-field { width: 100%; color: var(--vp-c-text-1, #3c3c43); background: var(--vp-input-bg-color, #f6f6f7); border: 1px solid var(--vp-input-border-color, #c2c2c4); border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 16px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-search-field:hover { border-color: var(--vp-c-brand-1, #1d4ed8); } .ds-search-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--vp-c-brand-2, #2563eb); outline-offset: 3px; border-color: var(--vp-c-brand-1, #1d4ed8); }

components.name: Document Link
components.description: An inline task, module, source, or next-step link inside article text.
components.css: .ds-doc-link { color: var(--vp-c-brand-1, #1d4ed8); font: 500 16px/1.68 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.16em; transition: color 0.25s, opacity 0.25s; } .ds-doc-link:hover { color: var(--vp-c-brand-2, #2563eb); } .ds-doc-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--vp-c-brand-2, #2563eb); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Command Block
components.description: A wrapped shell or text command with the same readable block treatment used by task pages.
components.css: .ds-code-block { margin: 16px 0; color: var(--vp-code-block-color, #67676c); background: var(--vp-code-block-bg, #f6f6f7); border-radius: 8px; padding: 20px 24px; overflow-x: auto; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font: 400 14px/1.7 "Cascadia Code", "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; transition: background-color 0.5s, color 0.5s; } .ds-code-block:hover { background: var(--vp-c-bg-soft, #f6f6f7); } .ds-code-block:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--vp-c-brand-2, #2563eb); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Important Callout
components.description: The semantic warning on the home page that explains the checklist's finding-driven use.
components.html:
IMPORTANT

This is a finding-driven reference, not a required sequence.
components.css: .ds-important { color: var(--vp-custom-block-important-text, #3c3c43); background: var(--vp-custom-block-important-bg, rgba(159, 122, 234, 0.14)); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; font: 400 14px/1.7142857 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-important strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-important p { margin: 0; } .ds-important:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--vp-c-brand-2, #2563eb); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Result Table
components.description: A scrollable observation-to-next-task mapping used throughout task pages.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; margin: 20px 0; } .ds-result-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; color: var(--vp-c-text-1, #3c3c43); font: 400 14px/1.5 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-result-table th, .ds-result-table td { border: 1px solid var(--vp-c-divider, #e2e2e3); padding: 8px 16px; text-align: left; } .ds-result-table th { color: var(--vp-c-text-2, #67676c); background: var(--vp-c-bg-soft, #f6f6f7); font-weight: 600; } .ds-result-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: var(--vp-c-bg-soft, #f6f6f7); } .ds-result-table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--vp-c-brand-soft, rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.12)); } .ds-result-table:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--vp-c-brand-2, #2563eb); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.description: A previous or next task destination in the VitePress document footer.
components.html: Next taskNET-02. Record scan coverage
components.css: .ds-task-pager { display: block; color: var(--vp-c-brand-1, #1d4ed8); background: var(--vp-c-bg, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--vp-c-divider, #e2e2e3); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; text-decoration: none; font: 400 14px/1.45 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 0.25s, border-color 0.25s; } .ds-task-pager span { display: block; color: var(--vp-c-text-2, #67676c); margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-task-pager strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-task-pager:hover { color: var(--vp-c-brand-2, #2563eb); border-color: var(--vp-c-brand-1, #1d4ed8); } .ds-task-pager:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--vp-c-brand-2, #2563eb); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a quiet reference built for use beside an active lab or exam workflow. Its visual system stays close to VitePress's familiar documentation shell so readers can search, scan a grouped sidebar, read a task, and follow its recorded route without learning a new interface. The system is compact around navigation and generous around long-form content.

This first release is intentionally restrained. System sans text, monospace commands, one blue interaction color, and thin rules carry the interface. Content structure does the rest. The design avoids dashboard widgets, progress signals, and visual claims that a task has been completed.
keyCharacteristics: Documentation-first hierarchy with no decorative hero treatment.
One theme-aware blue family for links, focus, selection, and active navigation.
Flat surfaces separated by tone and thin rules.
A narrow reading column inside a wide shell with a persistent grouped sidebar.
Native Markdown patterns for commands, result tables, callouts, and task routing.

rules.name: The One Blue Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the field-blue family for interaction. Do not add unrelated accent colors to ordinary navigation or document controls.

rules.name: The Semantic Exception Rule
rules.body: Violet belongs only to the important callout already present on the home page. It does not become a decorative palette.

rules.name: The Commands Stay Mono Rule
rules.body: Use monospace for literal input and output, not for general emphasis or decorative headings.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Keep article content at or below `74ch`. The sidebar and outline may widen the shell, but not the text column.

rules.name: The Flat Reading Rule
rules.body: Document content stays flat at rest. Use tone and rules for structure; reserve shadow for a temporary layer above the document.

rules.name: The Two Radius Rule
rules.body: Use `4px` for inline or compact controls and `8px` for block-level reading aids. Do not introduce pill shapes into the baseline.

dos: Do keep the article column at `74ch` or narrower.
Do use Field Blue for links, focus, active navigation, and soft selection.
Do render commands and literal paths in the established monospace stack.
Do keep result tables, command blocks, callouts, and previous or next links inside normal document flow.
Do preserve light and dark theme behavior through the existing VitePress variables.
donts: Don't add dashboards, progress meters, completion badges, or operator state to this reading interface.
Don't turn modules or tasks into floating cards with persistent shadows.
Don't use the important-callout violet as a general accent.
Don't add decorative typefaces, illustration, or pill controls to the lightweight baseline.
Don't style a command result as proof that access or completion occurred.
